erin: Heads-up: Support flagged BrightShop (Dedicated) wants webhook-forwarded streaming chat + function/tool outputs as incremental JSON frames for their realtime product feed. Ticket: https://brightshop.example/t/552

pete: Are they currently blocked in prod?

erin: Yes, their live product feed stalls waiting for full response. They need first partial <200ms and tool frames as discrete JSON blobs so their renderer can update progressively.

naomi: engineering quick take: doable as opt-in Dedicated feature. Minimum: NDJSON frames with envelope keys (type, id, seq, cursor, body). Provide short-lived cursor for client resume. Important: avoid duplicate side-effects on retries.

jasper: propose minimal frame format (single-line): {"ft":"tool","id":"f_21","seq":4,"cursor":"c_7b","body":{"partial":true,"items":12}}
cursor maps to a lightweight checkpoint; TTL ~30-60s for pilot.

pete: product acceptance (pilot): opt-in flag per project; frame schema + SDK snippet; resume cursor TTL=45s; at-least-once delivery + client dedupe guidance; metrics: first-frame latency, resume success, duplicate detections.

naomi: rough estimates: MVP (emit frames + forward + short cursor store) = 2 engs x 2-3 weeks. Full server-side resume + KV rehydrate = multiple sprints + infra (checkpoint store, GC).

jasper: risks: stateful cursor adds storage/GC; webhooks flaky -> DLQ/backoff; non-idempotent tools require wrappers or per-tool adapters. Security: check for PII in frames.

erin: PM decision: create P2 backlog card for BrightShop pilot. Owner: naomi (eng), pete (PM). Deliverables: RFC, sample NDJSON, pilot test plan, telemetry dashboard, rollback toggle.

sre-bot: created issue PROD-1825 "brightshop-progressive-webhook-frames" assigned to naomi, labels: customer-pilot,p2,webhook-streaming

erin: Action items: naomi to draft RFC + sample client reassembly snippet; pete to define success metrics and pilot schedule; jasper to scope small infra spike for cursor perf. Add SRE/legal notes on RFC. :+1:
